result.summary: The screen is largely coherent, but there are several visual defects: an empty icon button in the header, text truncation without ellipsis in the horizontal carousel, inconsistent styling of favorite buttons and card thumbnails, and content clipped behind the bottom navigation bar.

issues.description: The circular button in the top-right of the header is empty (light gray circle) apart from a small red notification dot — the expected icon (profile avatar or notification bell) appears to be missing or failed to load.
issues.suggestion: Render the intended icon/avatar inside the button, and add a fallback (initials or default glyph) if the image fails to load.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel the third card is cut hard by the viewport edge and its title reads 'Trattoria Piccol' with the word sliced mid-character and no ellipsis, making it look broken rather than scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent horizontal padding/peek so the next card shows a clear partial preview, and apply text truncation with ellipsis to card titles so clipped names read as intentional.

issues.description: The category chip row is also clipped at the right edge with a barely visible sliver of the next chip, giving no clear affordance that the row scrolls.
issues.suggestion: Show a consistent partial chip or add a fade/gradient mask at the right edge to signal horizontal scrolling.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently: white circle with dark outline heart on the ramen card, dark/translucent circle with white heart on the pizza card.
issues.suggestion: Use a single favorite button treatment (e.g., translucent dark scrim with white icon) across all cards for consistency and reliable contrast on any image.

issues.description: Thumbnail treatments in the 'Fastest near you' row are inconsistent — the Green Bowl Poké tile has a pale gray background while the other two are dark, so the white 'min' badge contrast varies and the row looks unbalanced.
issues.suggestion: Normalize image backgrounds or add a uniform dark gradient overlay behind the badges so all tiles read the same.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' card is abruptly cut off by the bottom navigation bar with no bottom padding, hiding its title/rating and making the list feel truncated.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset equal to the nav bar height so the last card can scroll fully into view.

issues.description: Icon-only controls (header button, heart/favorite buttons, search icon) have no visible text labels; if they also lack accessible names they are unusable with screen readers.
issues.suggestion: Provide accessible labels (e.g., 'Notifications', 'Add Tokumaru Ramen Bar to favorites') and ensure touch targets are at least 44x44 px.
